For the purpose of preventing
unnecessary annoyances that may
occur to foreign tourists to the
interior parts of this country, the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs has
published a pamphlet containing
facts relating to the issue of pass-
ports to alien travellers to the in-
terior. A large number of copies
of this pamphlet have been for-
warded to the Central as well as
Local Government organizations
for reference. This step is taken
in view of the diversified steps
taken by provincial, municipal and
other passport issuing offices in
granting passports and visas to
foreigners which have caused un-
necessary delay and difficulties to
applicants.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
TUESDAY, JANUARY 29, 1929

RULES FOR FOREIGN
TRAVELLERS

Forty-two Regulations Covering
Voyages Into the
Interior

A series of 42 regulations governing foreigners travelling in the interior have been published by the Commissioner of Foreign Affairs. Some of these are of interest and importance and should be noted by foreigners before they leave the treaty ports. We have translated the accompanying from the Chinese press in the order stated:—

Article 3: British, French, American, Japanese, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Belgian, Dutch, Portuguese, Spanish and other nationals having treaty rights in China, who have passports or licenses issued by their respective consuls and who wish to go to the Bureau of Foreign Affairs to be stamped must hand in three photos and the sum of $2, this being the stamp fee. (This regulation will come into force on February 1, 1929).

Article 4B: German, Austrian, Finnish, Brazilian and Mexican nationals, in applying for their visas must observe the above condition and accompany their applications with $3, "signature fee" ($2 stamp fee included). Permits for these nationals are effective for three months. The fee for "return permits" will be $5 and will be effective for one year.

Article 5: Russians applying for permits for travelling purposes must apply personally to the Bureau of Foreign Affairs and fill in the necessary forms.

The above two regulations are effective as from January 20, 1929.

Article 6: Foreigners of non-treaty powers who enjoy no extra-territorial rights, in applying for permits, must hand in their passport and certificates issued by the Bureau of Foreign Affairs together with two photos and $2.

(批：I suggest this be brought to notice of our men here 30/1)

1929年1月29日，星期二

外国旅客规则

涵盖进入内地旅行的四十二条规定

外事专员公布了一系列共42条关于外国人在内地旅行的规定。其中一些条款具有趣味性和重要性，外国人在离开通商口岸前应予以注意。我们按下列顺序翻译了中文报刊上的相关内容：—

第三条：在中国享有条约权利的英国、法国、美国、日本、丹麦、瑞典、挪威、比利时、荷兰、葡萄牙、西班牙及其他国籍人士，如持有各自领事签发的护照或执照，并希望前往外事局加盖印章，须提交三张照片及2元款项，此为印花费。（本规定将于1929年2月1日生效）。

第四条B：德国、奥地利、芬兰、巴西和墨西哥国籍人士在申请签证时必须遵守上述条件，并在申请时附带3元，“签名费”（含2元印花费）。这些人士的许可证有效期为三个月。“回程许可证”的费用为5元，有效期为一年。

第五条：俄罗斯人申请旅行许可证必须亲自向外事局申请并填写必要的表格。

以上两条规定自1929年1月20日起生效。

第六条：不享有治外法权的非条约国外国人，在申请许可证时，必须提交其护照及由外事局签发的证书，连同两张照片及2元款项。

（批注：我建议将此事项告知我处人员 1月30日）

Translation of the Temporary Regulations issued
on January 1, 1930, by the Bureau of Foreign Affairs of
Kiangsu (Shanghai) governing the visa of luchaos (passports),
registration and attestation of certificates:

Chapter 1. Luchao (Passports).

(1) Any Chinese desiring to go abroad for study,
travel or business should apply for a luchao. He must
call personally at this Bureau to fill up security and
investigation forms and produce three photos (size 4½ inches)
and pay a sum of $5, including $2 Duty Stamps. The life of
a luchao for persons going abroad for travel or business
is one year but those who go abroad for study may remain
abroad at their own wishes.
Apart from complying with the above rule, those
who go to the U.S.A. should fill up form No. 6 and
produce three more photos and pay $2 more as Duty Stamps.

(2) Except in special cases wherein this Bureau
decides that the filling up of the security form is not
necessary, Chinese intending to go abroad should comply
with the following rules when applying for security forms
to be signed and stamped by the guarantor:
(A) Those who intend to go abroad for study
should ask either the Principals of their
university or the World's Chinese Students'
Federation to act as guarantors.
(B) Those who intend to go abroad for travel
should ask the Tsen Keh Li Yin Say (中國旅行社)
or their fellow-provincials associations to introduce
some one to act as guarantor.
(C) Those who intend to go abroad on business
should ask the General Chamber of Commerce or the chairmen
of their respective guilds to introduce some person to act
as guarantor.

(3) Non-Treaty Power nationals, including Soviet
Russians and White Russians who are not in possession of
luchaos issued by their respective nations and who desire
to apply to this Bureau for luchaos to go abroad, should produce
the registration certificates issued to them by this Bureau
and fill up the investigation form, produce two photos
(size 4½ inches) and pay a fee of $3, including $2 Duty
Stamps. The life of the luchao is limited to one year.

(4) Non-Treaty Power nationals, regardless of
the fact whether or not they are in possession of national
passports, when applying for luchaos for travel, should
call at this Bureau, produce the registration certificates
issued by this Bureau, fill up the investigation form,
produce two photos and pay a fee of $3, including $2 Duty
Stamps. If the applicant desires to travel to more than
one province, he should produce one photo for each province.
The life of the luchao is limited to three months.

(5) Foreign merchants in this locality desiring
to send men to various places in this country to buy products
or collect accounts, should ask their respective Consuls
to write to this Bureau for the issue of interior commercial
luchaos. The letter should enclose three photos (size
4½ inches) and a fee of $4, including $2 Duty Stamps.
The life of this kind of luchao is limited to one year.

江苏（上海）外事局于1930年1月1日发布的关于路照（护照）签证、登记及证书证明的暂行条例译文：

第一章. 路照（护照）。

(1) 任何希望出国求学、旅行或经商的中国人应申请路照。他必须亲自到本局填写担保书和调查表，并提交三张照片（尺寸为4½英寸），缴纳5元款项，其中包括2元印花税票。出国旅行或经商者的路照有效期为一年，但出国求学者可根据个人意愿在国外停留。
除遵守上述规定外，前往美国者应填写第6号表格，再提交三张照片，并额外缴纳2元作为印花税票。

(2) 除非本局决定无需填写担保书的特殊情况外，拟出国的中国人在申请由担保人签署并盖章的担保书时，应遵守以下规则：
(A) 拟出国求学者应请其大学校长或世界中国学生联合会担任担保人。
(B) 拟出国旅行者应请中国旅行社 (Tsen Keh Li Yin Say) 或其同乡会介绍某人担任担保人。
(C) 拟出国经商者应请总商会或各行会主席介绍某人担任担保人。

(3) 非条约国国民，包括未持有本国签发之路照的苏俄人和白俄人，如欲向本局申请出国路照，应出示由本局签发的登记证书，填写调查表，提交两张照片（尺寸为4½英寸），并缴纳3元费用，其中包括2元印花税票。路照有效期限制为一年。

(4) 非条约国国民，无论是否持有本国护照，在申请旅行路照时，应前往本局，出示由本局签发的登记证书，填写调查表，提交两张照片，并缴纳3元费用，其中包括2元印花税票。如果申请人希望前往多个省份，每省需提交一张照片。路照有效期限制为三个月。

(5) 本地外商如欲派人前往国内各地采购产品或收取账款，应请其各自领事致函本局，申请签发内地商业路照。信函中应附有三张照片（尺寸为4½英寸）及4元费用，其中包括2元印花税票。此类路照的有效期限制为一年。

Chapter 2. Visa.

(6) The fee for visa is $5, including $1 Duty
Stamps. The normal term is three months, but the term
for those who go to a place and returns is limited to
one year and the fee is $5.

(7) Chinese, non-Treaty Power nationals may, prior
to the expiration of the term stipulated in the luchaos
for going abroad, ask the Foreign Consulates in this
locality to extend the term by visa. Those who call
at this Bureau for visa must pay the fee in accordance
with Article 1.

(8) Nationals of Treaty Powers who are in
possession of passports issued by their respective
nations when applying for visa on their passports for
proceeding to the interior on travel or for preaching
purposes or to pass through various ports in China for
abroad, should call at this Bureau personally to fill up
the investigation form and produce three photos.

(9) Nationals of Treaty Powers who are in possession
of passports issued to them by their respective Consuls in
this locality for travel in the interior, should send them
to this Bureau, through their Consulates, for a stamp to be
chopped by this Bureau. They should produce three photos
(size 4½ inches) and a stamp fee of $5.

(10) Upon their arrival in Shanghai, non-Treaty
Power nationals who are in possession of travelling luchaos
issued by the Chinese authorities at outports, should, prior
to the expiration of the term limit, call personally at this
Bureau to fill up the investigation form, produce one photo
(size 4½ inches) and $1 as examination fee. Unless their
luchaos have been examined by this Bureau, they are not
permitted to apply to this Bureau for visa of their luchaos.

(11) Upon their arrival in Shanghai, nationals of
non-Treaty Powers who are in possession of travelling luchaos
issued by the Chinese authorities at outports and who are
desirous of proceeding to other places should prior to the
expiration of the term limit, comply with Article 8 of these
regulations to call at this Bureau for visa.

Chapter 3. Registration.

(12) Nationals of non-Treaty Powers or foreigners
who have no Consular protection living in Shanghai or who
have stayed in Shanghai less than ten days, should report
personally at this Bureau. Those who intend to stay here
more than ten days should come to this Bureau for registration.
Those who fail to register after having stayed over ten days
will have to pay a double fee. Those who fail to register
after having stayed here for over one year, an additional
fee of $12 per year will be collected.

第二章. 签证。

(6) 签证费用为5元，其中包括1元印花税票。正常期限为三个月，但对于前往某地并返回者，期限限制为一年，费用为5元。

(7) 中国人及非条约国国民可在出国路照规定的期限届满前，请本地外国领事馆通过签证延长期限。那些前来本局办理签证者必须按照第一条规定缴纳费用。

(8) 持有本国签发护照的条约国国民，如在护照上申请签证以便前往内地旅行或传教，或经由中国的各个港口出国，应亲自到本局填写调查表并提交三张照片。

(9) 持有本地各自领事馆签发的用于内地旅行护照的条约国国民，应通过其领事馆将护照送至本局，由本局加盖印章。他们应提交三张照片（尺寸为4½英寸）及5元印花费。

(10) 持有由中国外埠当局签发的旅行路照的非条约国国民，抵达上海后，应在期限届满前亲自到本局填写调查表，提交一张照片（尺寸为4½英寸）及1元审查费。除非其路照已经过本局审查，否则不得向本局申请路照签证。

(11) 持有由中国外埠当局签发的旅行路照并希望前往其他地方的非条约国国民，抵达上海后，应在期限届满前，遵守本条例第八条规定，前往本局办理签证。

第三章. 登记。

(12) 居住在上海或在上海停留不足十天的无领事保护的非条约国国民或外国人，应亲自向本局报告。那些打算在此停留超过十天者应来本局进行登记。停留超过十天而未登记者须缴纳双倍费用。在此停留超过一年而未登记者，每年将加收12元费用。

(13) Applicants must call at the Bureau in person and sign
Investigation Bonds. They must bring with them two 2"
photographs and a registration fee of $3 ($1 stamp fee
included) for a period of one year. Travellers who
report themselves are exempted.

(14) Those who are in possession of huchaos or registration
certificates or other attestations certificates are exempted
from securing letters of recommendation or security when
they come to this Bureau for registration otherwise they
will be subject to the following regulations:-
    a) White Russians must secure letters of recommendation
and security from the Russian Emigrants Committee and
Relief Association or the Union of Russian Association or
upon appearance at this Bureau and the guarantee of over
two other White Russians who are already registered with
this Bureau.
    b) Soviet Russians must secure the recommendation and
security of respectable firms or upon appearance at this
Bureau and the guarantee of over two Soviet Russians who are
already registered with this Bureau.
    c) Non-Treaty nationals must secure the recommendation
and security of representatives of certain qualified public
bodies in Shanghai, which must be able to represent their
country and which must have been recognized by this Bureau
or upon appearance at this Bureau and the guarantee of
over two of his nationals who are already registered with
this Bureau.

(15) Soviet Russians who apply for registration at this Bureau
must produce passport issued by their own country, which will
be deposited at this Bureau until such time as the applicants
leave China.

(16) Persons who have been registered with this Bureau applying
for travelling passports or for visas on the original huchaos
have to return their registration certificates to this
Bureau before proceeding to any foreign country. These
certificates will be retained by this Bureau and returned
to their owners upon their return to Shanghai in exchange.
During the period when the registration certificates are kept
in the custody of this Bureau, the owners cannot enjoy the
privileges granted by the certificates.

(17) Those who have already been registered and who desire
to change their names on account of marriage must call at
this Bureau with their marriage certificate and apply
for permission to make such alterations.

(18) Those who have already been registered and who have a
birth or death in their family or who wish to change their
addresses must call at this Bureau and report same for
registration.

        Chapter 4. Attestation

(19) Chinese citizens who call at this Bureau to apply for
attestation certificates to be shown to foreigners must secure
letters of recommendation and security from the local Chambers
of Commerce, public bodies or Fellow Provincial Associations.
These letters must specify the matter to be certified. Upon
approval by this Bureau, attestation certificates will be issued.

(13) 申请人必须亲自到局签署调查保证书。他们必须携带两张2英寸照片及为期一年的3元登记费（含1元印花费）。自行报告的旅行者免除此项费用。

(14) 持有户口照 (huchaos)、登记证书或其他证明证书者在来本局登记时，免于获取推荐信或担保，否则他们将受以下规定约束：-
    a) 白俄人必须从俄国侨民委员会及救济协会或俄国联盟获得推荐信和担保，或者在本局露面并由两名以上已向本局登记的白俄人提供担保。
    b) 苏俄人必须从信誉良好的商号获得推荐和担保，或者在本局露面并由两名以上已向本局登记的苏俄人提供担保。
    c) 非条约国国民必须从上海某些有资格的公共团体代表处获得推荐和担保，这些团体必须能够代表其国家并已获得本局认可，或者在本局露面并由两名以上已向本局登记的同国人提供担保。

(15) 向本局申请登记的苏俄人必须出示由其本国签发的护照，该护照将由本局保管，直至申请人离开中国。

(16) 已在本局登记的人员，在申请旅行护照或在原户口照上办理签证时，必须在前往任何外国之前将登记证书交回本局。这些证书将由本局保留，并在其返回上海时交换归还。在登记证书由本局保管期间，持有人不能享受证书所赋予的特权。

(17) 已登记人员如因结婚希望更改姓名，必须携带结婚证书到本局申请批准进行此类更改。

(18) 已登记人员如家中发生出生或死亡事件，或希望更改地址，必须到本局报告以便登记。

        第四章. 证明

(19) 前来本局申请向外国人出示的证明证书的中国公民，必须从本地商会、公共团体或同乡会获得推荐信和担保。这些信件必须注明待证明的事项。经本局批准后，将签发证明证书。

(20) Nationals of Treaty Powers who call at this Bureau for Attestation Certificates must secure letters of recommendation from local Consuls who should specify the matter to be attested. Upon approval by this Bureau, attestation certificates will be issued.

(21) Non-Treaty nationals who call at this Bureau for attestation certificates must bring their registration certificates of the current year and fill an application form. Upon approval by this Bureau, attestation certificates will be issued.

(22) Those who desire certificates of birth, existence, death etc. must write applications themselves or by their nearest of kin together with a remittance of $3 ($1 stamp fee included)

(23) Marriage certificates will be issued upon the personal application and signature of the investigation bond by the direct superiors of the applicants together with the bride and bridegroom. The couple must each bring two-4" photographs and pay an attestation fee of $10. The issue of such certificates also depends upon the approval of this Bureau. If the applicants have no direct superiors, they may bring letters of security from local lawyers.

(24) Those who wish to remarry after divorce or after the death of one of the couple must bring their documents of divorce or the death certificate before their application can be granted for the issue of marriage certificates. In case the applicants are unable to produce such documents or attestation certificates, they should bring two witnesses who are already registered with this Bureau.

(25) Those who wish to enter as residents must call at this Bureau together with two others who are already registered to sign an application form and guarantee bond expressing their earning ability and bring two- 4" photographs and $8 ($2 stamp fee included) before permission is granted for the issue of admission certificates.

(26) Those who wish to apply for translation of attestation certificates must call at this Bureau to sign an application and a copy of the article to be translated which will be filed for reference purposes. A fee of $1 for every page containing 25 lines or the less of the certificates will be charged for the translation and a fee of 80 cents will be charged from the 11th page together with $1 stamp tax. Charges for duplicates will be half of the original price.

(27) Those who desire to have their attestations visaed should produce them at the Bureau of Foreign Affairs and tender a duplicate form of the attestations to this Bureau for reference purposes. A stamp tax of $1 is to be charged for each attestation certificate visaed. In addition, a charge of 1% of the value of the attestation certificate will be made. The fee for attestation certificates belonging to individuals is $1 and $2 for each attestation certificate belonging to a delegation.

(28) Prior to the temporary measures being put into force, the fees for attestation certificates to be visaed should be fixed at the request of the officer in the Passport Department.

(29) People of Non-Treaty Powers who are registered with this Bureau may get their attestation certificates visaed free of charge.

(25) 欲作为居民登记者，须与两名已注册人员一同前往本局，签署表达其谋生能力的申请表及保证书，并携带两张4英寸照片及8元（含2元印花税票费），经许可后方予签发准入证书。

(27) 欲对其证明书进行签证者，应向外事局出示证明书，并向本局提交证明书副本一份以备参考。每份经签证的证明书须缴纳1元印花税。此外，按证明书价值的1%收取费用。个人所有的证明书费用为1元，团体所有的每份证明书费用为2元。

Translation of the Temporary Regulations issued
on January 1, 1929, by the Bureau of Foreign Affairs of
Kiangsu (Shanghai) governing the visa of luchaos (passports),
registration and attestation of certificates:

Chapter 1. Luchao (Passports).

(1) Any Chinese desiring to go abroad for study,
travel or business should apply for a luchao. He must
call personally at this Bureau to fill up security and
investigation forms and produce three photos (size 4½ inches)
and pay a sum of $8, including $3 Duty Stamps. The life of
a luchao for persons going abroad for travel or business
is one year but those who go abroad for study may remain
abroad at their own wishes.
Apart from complying with the above rule, those
who go direct to the U.S.A. should fill up form No. 6 and
produce three more photos and pay $3 more as Duty Stamps.

(2) Except in special cases wherein this Bureau
decides that the filling up of the security form is not
necessary, Chinese intending to go abroad should comply
with the following rules when applying for security forms
to be signed and chopped by the guarantor:
(A) Those who intend to go abroad for study
should ask either the Principals of their
university or the World's Chinese Students
Federation to act as guarantors.
(B) Those who intend to go abroad for travel
should ask the Tsun Koh Li Yin Zay (      )
or their fellow-provincials associations to introduce
some one to act as guarantor.
(C) Those who intend to go abroad on business
should ask the General Chamber of Commerce or the chairmen
of their respective guilds to introduce some person to act
as guarantor.

(3) Non-Treaty Power nationals, including Soviet
Russians and White Russians who are not in possession of
luchaos issued by their respective nations and who desire
to apply to this Bureau for luchaos to go abroad, should produce
the registration certificates issued to them by this Bureau
and fill up the investigation form, produce two photos
(size 4½ inches) and pay a fee of $5, including $2 Duty
Stamps. The life of the luchao is limited to one year.

(4) Non-Treaty Power nationals, regardless of
the fact whether or not they are in possession of national
passports, when applying for luchaos for travel, should
call at this Bureau to produce the registration certificates
issued by this Bureau, fill up the investigation form,
produce two photos and pay a fee of $5, including $1 Duty
Stamps. If the applicant desires to travel to more than
one province, he should produce one photo for each province.
The life of the luchao is limited to three months.

(5) Foreign merchants in this locality desiring
to send men to various places in this country to buy products
or collect accounts, should ask their respective Consuls
to write to this Bureau for the issue of interior commercial
luchaos. The letter should enclose three photos (size
4½ inches) and a fee of $4, including $1 Duty Stamps.
The life of this kind of luchao is limited to one year.

江苏省（上海）外事局于1929年1月1日发布的关于路照（护照）签证、注册及证书证明的临时规章译文：

第一章 路照（护照）

(1) 凡中国人欲出国求学、旅行或经商者，应申请路照。须亲自前往本局填写担保及调查表格，提交三张照片（尺寸4½英寸），并缴纳8元，其中包括3元印花税票。出国旅行或经商者的路照有效期为一年，但出国求学者可根据自身意愿在国外停留。
除遵守上述规定外，直接前往美国者，须填写第6号表格，另提交三张照片，并额外缴纳3元印花税票。

(2) 除本局决定无需填写担保表的特殊情况外，拟出国的中国人在申请担保人签字盖章的担保表时，应遵守以下规定：
(A) 拟出国求学者，应请其大学校长或世界中国学生联合会担任担保人。
(B) 拟出国旅行者，应请存古里印字馆 (音译) 或其同乡会介绍某人担任担保人。
(C) 拟出国经商者，应请总商会或各行会主席介绍某人担任担保人。

(3) 非条约国国民，包括苏联人及白俄人，若未持有其本国签发的路照而欲向本局申请出国路照，须出示本局发给他们的注册证，填写调查表，提交两张照片（尺寸4½英寸），并缴纳5元费用，其中包括2元印花税票。路照有效期限制为一年。

(4) 非条约国国民，无论是否持有本国护照，若申请旅行路照，须前往本局出示本局签发的注册证，填写调查表，提交两张照片，并缴纳5元费用，其中包括1元印花税票。若申请人欲前往多个省份，每省须提交一张照片。路照有效期限制为三个月。

(5) 本地外商若欲派人前往国内各地采购产品或催收账款，应请其各自领事馆致函本局，申请签发内地商业路照。信函内须附三张照片（尺寸4½英寸）及4元费用，其中包括1元印花税票。此类路照有效期限制为一年。

to the expiration of the term stipulated in the passes
for going abroad, ask the foreign Consulates in this
locality to extend the term by Visa. Those who call
at this Bureau for visa must pay the fee in accordance

(8) Nationals of Treaty Powers who are in
possession of passports issued by their respective
nations when applying for visa on their passports for
proceeding to the interior on travel or for preaching
purposes or to pass through various ports in China for
abroad, should call at this Bureau personally to fill up
the investigation form and produce three photos.

(9) Nationals of Treaty Powers who are in possession
of passports issued to their by their respective Consuls in
this locality for travel in the interior, should send them
to this Bureau, through their Consulates, for a stamp to be
stamped by this Bureau. They should produce three photos
size 4½(inches) and a stamp fee of $3.

(10) Upon their arrival in Shanghai, non-Treaty
Power nationals who are in possession of travelling passes
issued by the Chinese authorities at outports, should prior
to the expiration of the term limit, call personally at this
Bureau to fill up the investigation form, produce one photo
(size 4½ inches) and $1 as examination fee. Unless their
passes have been examined by this Bureau, they are not
permitted to apply to this Bureau for visa of their passes.

(11) Upon their arrival in Shanghai, nationals of
non-Treaty Powers who are in possession of travelling passes
issued by the Chinese authorities at outports and who are
desirous of proceeding to other places should prior to the
expiration of the term limit, comply with Article 8 of these
regulations to call at this Bureau for visa.

Chapter 3. Registration.

(12) Nationals of non-Treaty Powers or foreigners
who have no Consular protection living in Shanghai or who
have stayed in Shanghai less than ten days, should report
personally at this Bureau. Those who intend to stay here
more than ten days should come to this Bureau for registration.
Those who fail to register after having stayed over ten days
will have to pay a double fee. Those who fail to register
after having stayed here for over one year, an additional
fee of $12 per year will be collected.

have to return their registration certificates to this

to their owners upon their return to Shanghai in exchange.

in the custody of this Bureau, the owners cannot enjoy the
privileges granted by the certificates.

(17) Those who have already been registered and who desire
to change their names on account of marriage must call at
this Bureau with their matrimonial certificate and apply
for permission to make such alterations.

(18) Those who have already been registered and who have a
birth or death in their family or who wish to change their
addresses must call at this Bureau and report same for

Chapter 4. Attestation

(19) Chinese citizens who call at this Bureau to apply for
Attestation certificates to be shown to foreigners must secure
letters of recommendation and security from the local Chambers
of Commerce, public bodies or Fellow Provincial Associations.
These letters must specify the matter to be certified. Upon

(13) 申请人必须亲自前往本局并签署调查保证书。他们须携带两张4英寸照片及为期一年的注册费5元（含印花税票1元）。自行报到的旅客免予办理。

(14) 持有户口证、注册证书或其他证明证书者，前来本局注册时，免予提供推荐信或担保；否则，须遵守下列规定：-
a) 白俄须取得俄国侨民委员会与救济协会，或俄国协会联盟的推荐信和担保；或在本局面前出现，并由两名以上已在本局注册的白俄提供担保。
b) 苏俄人须取得信誉良好的商号的推荐和担保；或在本局面前出现，并由两名以上已在本局注册的苏俄人提供担保。
c) 非条约国国民须取得上海某些合格公共团体代表的推荐和担保，该等团体必须能够代表其国家，且已获本局认可；或在本局面前出现，并由两名以上已在本局注册的同国籍人士提供担保。

(15) 向本局申请注册的苏俄人，必须出示由其本国签发的护照，该护照将存放于本局，直至申请人离开中国为止。

(16) 已在本局注册的人员，在申请旅行护照或在原户口证上签证时，须在前往任何外国之前，将注册证书交回本局。这些证书将由本局保留，并在其返回上海时予以发还，以作交换。在注册证书由本局保管期间，持有人不得享受该证书所赋予的特权。

(17) 已注册者如因结婚欲更改姓名，须持结婚证书前往本局，申请批准进行此类变更。

(18) 已注册者如家中发生出生或死亡事件，或欲更改地址，须前往本局申报以便登记。

第四章. 证明

(19) 中国公民前往本局申请用于向外国人出示的证明证书，须取得当地商会、公共团体或同乡会的推荐信和担保。这些信件必须注明需证明的事项。经本局批准后，将签发证明证书。

(20) Nationals of Treaty Powers who call at this Bureau for
Attestation Certificates must secure letters of recommendation
from local Consuls who should specify the matter to be
attested. Upon approval by this Bureau, attestation
certificates will be issued.

(21) Non-Treaty nationals who call at this Bureau for attestation
certificates must bring their registration certificates of
the current year and fill an application form. Upon approval
by this Bureau, attestation certificates will be issued.

(22) Those who desire certificates of birth, existence, death
etc. must write applications themselves or by their nearest
of kin together with a remittance of $3 ($1 stamp fee included)

(23) Marriage certificates will be issued upon the personal
application and signature of the investigation bond by the
directs superiors of the applicants together with the bride
and bridegroom. The couple must each bring two-4½"
photographs and pay an attestation fee of $10. The issue of
such certificates also depends upon the approval of this
Bureau. If the applicants have no direct superiors, they may
bring letters of security from local lawyers.

(24) Those who wish to remarry after divorce or after the
death of one of the couple must bring their documents of
divorce or the death certificate before their application
can be granted for the issue of marriage certificates. In
case the applicants are unable to produce such documents
or attestation certificates, they should bring two witnesses
who are already registered with this Bureau.

(25) Those who wish to enter as residents must call at this
Bureau together with two others who are already registered
to sign an application form and guarantee bond expressing
their earning ability and bring two- 4½" photographs and
$8 ($2 stamp fee included) before permission is granted
for the issue of admission certificates.

(26) Those who wish to apply for translation of attestation
certificates must call at this Bureau to sign an application
and a copy of the article to be translated which will be
filed for reference purposes. A fee of $1 for every page
containing 25 lines or less of the certificates will
be charged for the translation and a fee of 80 cents will be

Translation of the Temporary Regulations issued
on January 1, 1929, by the Bureau of Foreign Affairs of
Kiangsu (Shanghai) governing the visa of luchao (passports),
registration and attestation of certificates:

Chapter 1. Luchao (Passports).

(1) Any Chinese desiring to go abroad for study,
travel or business should apply for a luchao. He must
call personally at this Bureau to fill up security and
investigation forms and produce three photos (size 4½ inches)
and pay a sum of $5, including $3 Duty Stamps. The life of
a luchao for persons going abroad for travel or business
is one year but those who go abroad for study may remain
abroad at their own wishes.
Apart from complying with the above rule, those
who go direct to the U.S.A. should fill up form No. 6 and
produce three more photos and pay $2 more as Duty Stamps.

(2) Except in special cases wherein this Bureau
decides that the filling up of the security form is not
necessary, Chinese intending to go abroad should comply
with the following rules when applying for security forms
to be signed and chopped by the guarantor:
(A) Those who intend to go abroad for study
should ask either the Principals of their
university or the World's Chinese Students
Federation to act as guarantors.
(B) Those who intend to go abroad for travel
should ask the Tsum Keh Li Yin Iay (      )
or their fellow-provincials associations to introduce
some one to act as guarantor.
(C) Those who intend to go abroad on business
should ask the General Chamber of Commerce or the chairmen
of their respective guilds to introduce some person to act
as guarantor.

(3) Non-Treaty Power nationals, including Soviet
Russians and White Russians who are not in possession of
luchaos issued by their respective nations and who desire
to apply to this Bureau for luchaos to go abroad, should produce
the registration certificates issued to them by this Bureau
and fill up the investigation form, produce two photos
(size 4½ inches) and pay a fee of $3, including $2 Duty
Stamps. The life of the luchao is limited to one year.

(4) Non-Treaty Power nationals, regardless of
the fact whether or not they are in possession of national
passports, when applying for luchao for travel, should
call at this Bureau to produce the registration certificates
issued by this Bureau, fill up the investigation form,
produce two photos and pay a fee of $3, including $1 Duty
Stamps. If the applicant desires to travel to more than
one province, he should produce one photo for each province.
The life of the luchao is limited to three months.

(5) Foreign merchants in this locality desiring
to send men to various places in this country to buy products
or collect accounts, should ask their respective Consuls
to write to this Bureau for the issue of interior commercial
luchaos. The letter should enclose three photos (size
4½ inches) and a fee of $4, including $1 Duty Stamps.
The life of this kind of luchao is limited to one year.

第一章. 路照（护照）。

(1) 任何中国人欲出国求学、旅行或经商，应申请路照。他必须亲自前往本局填写担保及调查表格，出示三张照片（尺寸为4½英寸），并缴纳5元，其中包括3元印花税票。出国旅行或经商者的路照有效期为一年，但出国求学者可根据自身意愿在国外停留。
除遵守上述规定外，直接前往美国者，须填写第6号表格，另出示三张照片，并额外缴纳2元作为印花税票。

(2) 除本局决定无需填写担保表的特殊情况外，拟出国的中国人在申请担保人签署并盖章的担保表时，应遵守下列规则：
(A) 拟出国求学者，应请其大学校长或世界中国学生联合会担任担保人。
(B) 拟出国旅行者，应请总商会 (Tsum Keh Li Yin Iay) （原文不清）或其同乡会介绍某人担任担保人。
(C) 拟出国经商者，应请总商会或各自公会的主席介绍某人担任担保人。

(3) 非条约国国民，包括未持有本国签发之路照而欲向本局申请路照出国的苏俄人和白俄人，应出示本局向其签发的注册证书，填写调查表，出示两张照片（尺寸为4½英寸），并缴纳3元费用，其中包括2元印花税票。路照有效期限制为一年。

(4) 非条约国国民，无论是否持有本国护照，在申请旅行路照时，应前往本局出示本局签发的注册证书，填写调查表，出示两张照片，并缴纳3元费用，其中包括1元印花税票。如申请人欲前往多个省份，每省须出示一张照片。路照有效期限制为三个月。

(5) 本地外商欲派人至国内各地采购产品或收取账款，应请其各自领事致函本局，申请签发内地商业路照。信函中应附有三张照片（尺寸为4½英寸）及4元费用，其中包括1元印花税票。此类路照有效期限制为一年。

bring letters of security from local lawyers.

death of one of the couple must bring their documents of
divorce or the death certificate before their application
can be granted for the issue of marriage certificates. In
case the applicants are unable to produce such documents
or attestation certificates, they should bring two witnesses
who are already registered with this Bureau.

Bureau together with two others who are already registered
to sign an application form and guarantee bond expressing
their earning ability and bring two- 4½" photographs and
$8 ($2 stamp fee included) before permission is granted
for the issue of admission certificates.

certificates must call at this Bureau to sign an application
and a copy of the article to be translated which will be
filed for reference purposes. A fee of $1 for every page
containing 25 lines or less of the certificates will
be charged for the translation and a fee of 50 cents will be
charged from the 11th page together with $1 stamp tax.
Charges for duplicates will be half of the original price.

produce them at the Bureau of Foreign Affairs and tender a
duplicate form of the attestations to this Bureau for reference
purposes. A stamp tax of $1 is to be charged for each
attestation certificate visaed. In addition, a charge of 1%
of the value of the attestation certificate will be made.
The fee for attestation certificates belonging to individuals
is $1 and $3 for each attestation certificate belonging
to a delegation.

(28) Prior to the temporary measures being put into force, the
fees for attestation certificates to be visaed should be
fixed at the request of the officer in the Passport Depart-
ment.

(29) People of Non-Treaty Powers who are registered with this
Bureau may get their attestation certificates visaed free of
charge.

(27) 希望对其证明进行签证者，应将其提交至外事局，并向本局提交一份证明副本以备查考。每份签证的证明证书收取1元印花税。此外，还将按证明证书价值的1%收取费用。属于个人的证明证书费用为1元，属于代表团的每份证明证书费用为3元。
